completedText: Return to Balir Frosthammer at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.
details: I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.$b$bI hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.$b$bAnd that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west! $b$bWe're a bit shorthanded here, $g lad : lass;, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
objectives: Balir Frosthammer wants you to kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs.
title: A New Threat

completedText: Return to Sten Stoutarm at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.
details: What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?$b$bI'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.$b$bI need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?
objectives: Sten Stoutarm would like 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat.
title: Dwarven Outfitters

completedText: Return to Grelin Whitebeard in Dun Morogh.
details: My brother Senir and I were sent to different parts of Dun Morogh to investigate the threat posed by the trolls. The Senate has its hands full with the troggs, so they've no need for further annoyances.$b$bFrom what I've seen, the trolls aren't well situated here in Coldridge Valley--mostly the southern cave. I'd say that the army will not be necessary. A few strong arms should be more than enough.$b$bPerhaps you'd like to assist in this endeavor? I have the authority to offer compensation for your help.
objectives: Grelin Whitebeard would like you to kill 10 Frostmane Troll Whelps.
title: The Troll Cave

completedText: Return to Talin Keeneye at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.
details: Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?$b$bThough, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.$b$bLong story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.
objectives: Talin Keeneye would like you to kill 8 Small Crag Boars.
title: The Boar Hunter

completedText: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Stranglethorn Vale.
details: $N, you are a hunter worthy of our company.  From the battlefields of Lordaeron to the deepest jungle, I have rarely witnessed such prowess with weaponry as you have demonstrated.$b$bYou have killed the ferocious Sin'Dall, the elusive Bag'thera and the treacherous Tethis.  But the true prize is the head of King Bangalash.  That white tiger is the reason I am here.  I've had my sights on him for quite some time now.  Kill King Bangalash and your hunting prowess is proven to be second to none.
objectives: Hemet Nesingwary Jr. wants you to bring him the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
title: Big Game Hunter

completedText: Return to Grelin Whitebeard in Dun Morogh.
details: My journal! They took it away to the cave. The one that had it... It was a big brute with some odd markings on his skin and face. I didn't get a much better look than that.$b$bYou've had some luck with the trolls, maybe you could go get it back for me?
objectives: Grelin Whitebeard wants you to kill Grik'nir the Cold, and retrieve his journal.
title: The Stolen Journal

details: Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, $g lad : lass;? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.$b$bThey're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.$b$bWhat do you say?
objectives: Deliver the stack of letters to Talin Keeneye in Coldridge Valley.
title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

details: If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.
objectives: Deliver the letter to Grelin Whitebeard in Coldridge Valley.
title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

details: Attention, young adventurers!  The wilds of Ashenvale await you!$B$BThe Horde has established a strong presence in the lands north of the Barrens.  Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the Horde!  Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there.  Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the Barrens, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of Ashenvale!
objectives: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
title: The Ashenvale Hunt

details: I was planning on sending my apprentice to my brother Senir with my report, but I would feel much better were it placed in more... reliable hands. That is, of course, if you wouldn't mind?$b$bHmm... you'll have to take the tunnel to get to Kharanos.$b$bSpeak with Mountaineer Thalos before going through the tunnel. It's completely infested with troggs now.$b$bFollow the road back to Anvilmar, then keep heading east to the tunnel, Thalos is stationed nearby.
objectives: Speak with Mountaineer Thalos.
title: Senir's Observations

completedText: Return to Senir Whitebeard at Shimmer Ridge in Dun Morogh.
details: I'm behind on my report, and could use your help, $n. I just managed to find where the trolls are holed up, but I saw so many trolls, I was afraid to go in.$b$bHere's what I need... Go down to the cave, poke around inside, kill a few of the trolls, then come back here.$b$bTake the road north out of Kharanos, when you get to the bridge, follow the frozen river west until you reach Iceflow Lake. You'll find Brewnall Village on the west bank. The Hold is southwest of the village.
objectives: Explore Frostmane Hold, and kill 5 Frostmane Headhunters for Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
title: Frostmane Hold

completedText: Return to Pilot Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh.
details: Driving a Siege Engine isn't for everyone.  It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both!  How about you?  How's your mettle?  Want to prove it to me?$B$BWell...I'm looking to make my engine, Trollplow, a little more cozy.  How about you get me a heap of Wendigo Manes from the Grizzled Den, west of Kharanos.  Those manes would make a great rug for Trollplow's inside deck!
objectives: Gather 8 Wendigo Manes and bring them to Pilot Stonegear.
title: The Grizzled Den

completedText: Return to Pilot Bellowfiz at The Tundrid Hills in Dun Morogh.
details: I'm preparing to start a mission for the Siege Brigade.  It's a long one, and I need to stock Jetsteam with a month's worth of supplies.  So while Steelgrill is working on my tank, can you do some hunting for me?$B$BI'll need some fur for bedding, and boar meat for food.  You can get meat from boars and fur from the bears... you can find them both in the snow fields south of the Grizzled Den.
objectives: Gather 4 Chunks of Boar Meat and 2 Thick Bear Furs, and deliver them to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.
title: Stocking Jetsteam

details: Rejold Barleybrew experiments with his brews.  Some of them taste good, some bad, and some...well, some will lay all but the stoutest dwarf flat.$B$BHe lives at Brewnall Village, west of Kharanos, and one of his drinks, Evershine, is what I want.  It'll help keep me warm while I'm on the cold road.$B$BAnd...the blessed stuff burns so hot I can throw it in Jetsteam's furnace for a burst of power!  That little tactic has gotten me out of more than one tight spot.
objectives: Get a cask of Evershine from Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.
title: Evershine

completedText: Return to Executor Zygand at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.
details: Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in northern Tirisfal, past Faol's Rest.  According to the information we have, a ruthless commander named Captain Melrache is in charge of this evil crew.$b$bI am entrusting you now with a special and dangerous mission.  Slay Melrache and his two bodyguards, in the name of The Dark Lady.
objectives: Executor Zygand in the town of Brill wants you to assassinate Captain Melrache and his two bodyguards.
title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

completedText: Return to Ragnar Thunderbrew at Shimmer Ridge in Dun Morogh.
details: Nothing my tavern patrons enjoy more than some Beer Basted Boar Ribs!  Only problem is, the local trapper who used to bring me supplies enlisted in the King's Army to help with the war on the Alliance front. $b$bMaybe you can help me out?  If you bring me six crag boar ribs and a Rhapsody Malt from the tavern here, I'll give you the family recipe for my famous Beer Basted Boar Ribs, not to mention a free sample!  The secret's in the Malt!
objectives: Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos wants 6 Crag Boar Ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt.
title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

details: Beldin Steelgrill owns the local mechanic shop, and he's the best siege engine tech there is!  But he's not forgiving to his tools.  I swear he almost breaks more arclight spanners than we can supply him with!$B$BWe just filled his last order for tools.  If you deliver it to him I'm sure he'll make it worth the effort.$B$BHis shop, Steelgrill's Depot, is just northeast of Kharanos.  And it's a local haunt for veteran siege engine pilots, so keep your ears open for opportunities while you're there.
objectives: Deliver Steelgrill's Tools to Beldin Steelgrill.
title: Tools for Steelgrill

details: Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful mage in the Undercity to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge.  You, $N, will be that agent.$B$BPresent these orders to Bethor.  He will then instruct you on your mission.  I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich.  And it will be dangerous.$B$BSo ready yourself, $C.  You must not fail.$B$BYou may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
objectives: Present Sevren's Orders to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
title: The Prodigal Lich

completedText: Return to Razzle Sprysprocket in Dun Morogh.
details: Upon further analysis of the Gnomeregan situation, it would appear as though we not only failed to eradicate the troggs but we also happened to turn most of the gnomish race into horrific, mindless, evil-doing leper gnomes.$b$bOzzie and I plan to reverse the horrible leper effect with our latest invention: The Recombobulator.  The machine is almost complete but we are in dire need of some Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears.  Retrieve some from the leper gnomes out front of Gnomeregan for us.
objectives: Bring Razzle Sprysprocket in Kharanos 8 Restabilization Cogs and 8 Gyromechanic Gears.
title: Operation Recombobulation

details: The troggs in the tunnel are extremely hostile, and haven't shown any hesitation in attacking travelers through the tunnel. You seem tough enough, though, so you should probably be safe.$b$bDirections? If you're going to speak with Senir, you'll find him in Kharanos.$b$bMake your way through the tunnel, and after you come out on the other side, just keep following the road, it'll run right into Kharanos.
objectives: Deliver Grelin's report to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
title: Senir's Observations

details: Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas.  Surely you know this by now.$b$bAs a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.$b$bTake these findings to Apothecary Renferrel who is stationed at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.  Follow the roads to the south from Brill.  From the Undercity go southwest.
objectives: Take Apothecary Johaan's findings to Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest.
title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

completedText: Return to Shards of Myzrael in The Hinterlands.
details: You must defeat Myzrael before she grows in strength.  If you do not, then once she has gathered enough power she will challenge her captors!  There are some who think they can control her, but if she can be controlled then why did the giants chain her in the first place??$B$BCrazy logic, eh?$B$BTo defeat her, summon her at the Shards of Myzrael where you first spoke with her.  Defeat her and gather her Eldritch Shackles, then bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.$B$BDo that, and she will again be trapped.
objectives: Go to the Shards of Myzrael, summon her and defeat her.$B$BGather her Eldritch Shackles and bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.
title: Summoning the Princess

completedText: Return to Brewmaster Drohn at Ratchet in the Barrens.
details: Good stuff, that stormstout, huh?$B$BI have another recipe that I learned from Chen. Would you be interested? It won't take long to make, and it might be useful if you plan on adventuring some more.$B$BBring me 5 lightning glands from any stormhide, 1 thunderhawk saliva gland from greater thunderhawks, and a kodo liver from any of the Barrens' kodos.$B$BLike I said, this stuff has kick; it's the trogg ale that I mentioned to you before.
objectives: Bring 5 Lightning Glands, 1 Thunderhawk Saliva Gland and 1 Kodo Liver to Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet.
title: Chen's Empty Keg

details: Gazlowe told me once, "Rezlak. There's one thing you need to know in life, and that's if you want something done well, do it yourself."$b$bI can't deal with losing all our caravans, so I'm just going to take matters into my own hands. Drygulch Ravine lies through the eastern part of Razorwind Canyon. If we kill all the harpies there, the routes will be safe.$b$bOf course, there was one other thing that Gazlowe taught me, and that's "You can get anything done for a price." So, going to help me out, $n?
objectives: Kill 12 Dustwind Savages and 8 Dustwind Storm Witches for Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
title: Securing the Lines

completedText: Return to Gann Stonespire at the Southern Gold Road in the Barrens.
details: In solitude I wander these roads.$b$bThe dwarves of Bael Modan show no respect for my land. Horrendous blasts drive holes deep into the ground as noisy machines rip apart the hills. Lands which once served as home and provider to my tribe are now riddled with destructive dwarves.$b$bAttempts at reaching a diplomatic resolution have failed. Now is the time for decisive action.$b$bDrive the dwarves from the Bael Modan excavation by force and bring to me the journal of their leader, Prospector Khazgorm.
objectives: Gann Stonespire wants you to kill 15 Bael'dun Excavators and 5 Bael'dun Foremen.$b$bBring Khazgorm's Journal to Gann Stonespire.
title: Gann's Reclamation

completedText: Return to Gann Stonespire at the Southern Gold Road in the Barrens.
details: It is clear the prospector depended on explosives and those noisy vehicles to rip the ground apart. We can expect a new foreman to take over soon.$b$bI want to give the dwarves a taste of their own medicine. According to these plans if we combine nitroglycerin with wood pulp and sodium nitrate we can create an explosive charge. The rifleman, soldiers and officers in the Keep are known to have the supplies.$b$bCollect these items and bring them to me. I will fashion a charge that the dwarves won't forget!
objectives: Gann Stonespire wants you to bring him 6 vials of Nitroglycerin, 6 bundles of Wood Pulp, and 6 samples of Sodium Nitrate.
title: Revenge of Gann

completedText: Return to Gann Stonespire at the Southern Gold Road in the Barrens.
details: Following Khazgorm's plans it should be no problem to fashion an explosive charge$b$bAh, there we go.$b$bNow, $n, I am going to entrust you with a special task. Take this explosive stick and use it to blow up the flying machine at Bael Modan.$b$bNot only is the flying machine a key part of the site's infrastructure it also serves as a weapon of war. More importantly it is an icon of power and an insult to the memory of my tribe.$b$bMake me proud by completing this heroic task and you shall be rewarded.
objectives: Destroy the flying machine at Bael Modan and return to Gann Stonespire.
title: Revenge of Gann

completedText: Return to Grub in The Barrens.
details: A $c like you must get pretty hungry out here in The Barrens. Me, I'm starving all day long.$b$bTell you what, I'll fix you up a nice stew. Just need a few dig rats.$b$bSeems those filthy dwarves at Bael Modan are overrun with everyone's favorite feast. Now head on down south to Bael Modan and bring me back some dig rats.$b$bYou can't call yourself a seasoned adventurer until you've spent some time killing rats! Haw!
objectives: Bring 8 Dig Rats to Grub east of the Crossroads.
title: Dig Rat Stew

completedText: Return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.
details: You must strike my enemies. <snort> You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. <snort> It gives us strength in all things... especially war.$B$BIf you want to find out who really causes Thork <snort> and the Horde such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the Barrens.
objectives: Kill 6 Bristleback Water Seekers, 12 Bristleback Thornweavers and 12 Bristleback Geomancers and return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
title: Tribes at War

completedText: Return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.
details: Three of my tribe came out of the Kraul to lead the raids against the Horde, $r. <snort> They are ruthless and cunning, and if you defeat them, then your Crossroads and even most of the Barrens will learn peace... <snort> at least from the Razormane tribe. <snort>$B$BNak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are the ones you seek. They are far to the south  of the Barrens. One is a spell caster, another a tracker, and their leader, the one called Orcbane, <snort> a warrior. Kill them, $r, like they have killed me.
objectives: Kill Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane and bring their skulls to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
title: Betrayal from Within

completedText: Return to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.
details: Ishamuhale, Speartooth, is the fiercest sunscale raptor of the Barrens.  He does not hunt for sport, nor for food.  He hunts because hunting is his passion.  He kills because it is his nature to kill.$B$BAnd you will learn of his nature, $N, for your path now follows the taloned tracks of Ishamuhale.$B$BBegin the hunt.  Slay his favorite prey, a zhevra, then bring its carcass to the dead tree northwest of Ratchet.  Ishamuhale will smell the carcass and be drawn to it.$B$BBe ready when he comes.
objectives: Bring Ishamuhale's Fang to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
title: Ishamuhale

details: The feather of Washte Pawne is painful to the touch.
objectives: Bring Washte Pawne's Feather to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
title: Washte Pawne

completedText: Return to Gazlowe in The Barrens.
details: While I'd like to recover all my goods, I'm sure that's not possible. Still, there's a few things that I absolutely must have!$b$bAs you see, my observatory is ready to go, but it needs the smaller of the two lenses. The first arrived by caravan from Durotar, but the second was bound by ship, and never arrived. Also, I never got my boot shipment from Drizzlik in Booty Bay!$b$bHead down to the pirate camp and see if you can find them.
objectives: Retrieve the Shipment of Boots and Telescopic Lens for Gazlowe in Ratchet.
title: Stolen Booty

completedText: Return to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.
details: The Razormane quilboars to the south, beyond the Field of Giants, have no skilled blacksmiths from what I am told, but they've apparently started to develop sturdier weapons. I'd like to get my hands on a few different types to learn their techniques if possible.$B$BIf you wish to help bring honor to the Horde, then bring me examples of their weapons. Find me a dagger from their stalkers, a wand from their seers, and a shield from their warfrenzy. That should do nicely!
objectives: Bring a Razormane Backstabber, a Charred Razormane Wand and a Razormane War Shield to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
title: Weapons of Choice

details: Take Lok's head to Thork in the Crossroads, $r. <snort> He should know what has happened to my tribe without any words--ha, not that he would believe Mangletooth helped in <snort> such things. But I am sure he'll reward you for carrying out such a great deed. <snort>$B$BI will continue to bless you with Agamaggan's power for as long as I remain in this cage, $r. Until then, farewell.
objectives: Bring Lok's Skull to Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
title: Betrayal from Within

completedText: Return to Nara Wildmane at The Golden Plains in Mulgore.
details: The druids in the Wailing Caverns, the Druids of the Fang, are an aberration.  They were part of an order of noble druids whose plan was to heal the Barrens, but now seek to remake that land to match their own, twisted dreams.$B$BThe Druids of the Fang have four leaders, and each possesses a dream gem.  Even now their faces haunt me!  Defeat the leaders and bring me their gems, and the Barrens may again know peace.$B$BGo, $N.  You will find them lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns.
objectives: Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
title: Leaders of the Fang

details: Excuse me $c, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.$B$BThe Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is most interested in seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project.  While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Hamuul Runetotem is spearheading this research.$B$BPlease - if you are interested, speak with him directly on the Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff proper.
objectives: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
title: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem

details: Attention, heroes!$B$BThe Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor!  A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.$B$BAll interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle.  Speak with the Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder's Rise of Thunder Bluff for more information!
objectives: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
title: The New Frontier

details: You've done so well for me, $n. You're a regular lucky rabbit's foot and there's something I want you to see.$B$BThe harpies are not from around the Barrens. They come from a place called Stonetalon, far to the northwest of here. Though it is probably a dangerous place for you, I need this letter delivered to an old friend of mine who lives there, a witch doctor by the name of Jin'Zil.$B$BHe'll be happy to know that Serena Bloodfeather is dead, and I think you'll find Stonetalon an interesting place.
objectives: Deliver Darsok's letter to Jin'Zil within his cave in Malaka'Jin, in Stonetalon.
title: Letter to Jin'Zil

completedText: Return to Mebok Mizzyrix at Ratchet in the Barrens.
details: Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay!  The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.$B$BI smell an opportunity!$B$BIn Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider.  Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!$B$BIn Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.$B$BIn Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...
objectives: Bring 15 Deepmoss Eggs to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

completedText: Return to Ziz Fizziks at Windshear Crag in Stonetalon Mountains.
details: I met Gerenzo once, but let me tell you, he's not easy on the eyes. His flesh looks like it's rotting away, and he's grafted metal and gears onto his body, replaced some of his limbs with mechanical ones.$b$bNortheast of here, far above Cragpool Lake, up near the water wheel is where Gerenzo watches over the entire site. There's no way I could fight my way up there, not to mention take on Gerenzo... But you look like you might be able to make it.$b$bIf you kill him for me, I'll make it worth your while!
objectives: Bring Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle's Mechanical Arm to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.
title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

details: $N, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.$B$BIf you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor.  You will find him on Hunter's Rise.
objectives: Speak with Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
title: Melor Sends Word

details: There, I did what Razzeric wanted. Just tell him to be careful when he sets this off. If he makes the slightest mistake, he won't be moving forward, he'll just be a burnt spot on the track.$b$bWould be a shame, too, if that happened. Who knows if our nineteenth driver would be any good?
objectives: Return the Modified Seaforium Booster to Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles.
title: Safety First

completedText: Return to Mebok Mizzyrix in The Barrens.
details: Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world!  But they're rare, very rare.  The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.$B$BAnd even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look!  That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me.  They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.$B$BIt won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.
objectives: Grab a Crate with Holes.$BGrab a Snufflenose Command Stick.$BGrab and read the Snufflenose Owner's Manual.$B$BIn Razorfen Kraul, use the Crate with Holes to summon a Snufflenose Gopher, and use the Command Stick on the gopher to make it search for Tubers.$B$BBring 6 Blueleaf Tubers, the Snufflenose Command Stick and the Crate with Holes to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
title: Blueleaf Tubers

details: The Venture Company stole many of the best goblin minds, but from time to time, we get the opportunity to steal some back.$b$bA while ago, the Venture Company outfit in the Stonetalon Mountains hired Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle--a gnome! Their other engineer, Ziz Fizziks, was so taken aback by this, he pleaded with me to find him new employment with the Tinkers' Union. I set him on a few tasks, but he might need help.$b$bMaybe you could look in on him for me? He's stationed at the western edge of Windshear Crag.
objectives: Speak with Ziz Fizziks in Windshear Crag in Stonetalon Mountains.
title: Ziz Fizziks

details: The shells you brought me have a taint, one I have never before seen.  I am certain the water of the Oases is the cause, and I can sense the confusion they cause this land.  It is as if the land dreams and cannot awake.$B$BThe Wailing Caverns must be the source of the taint.  But before you go there, speak with Hamuul Runetotem, the elder druid.  I sent word to him of the happenings in the Barrens.  He is wise, and can offer you counsel.$B$BYou will find him in Thunder Bluff, on the Elder Rise.
objectives: Speak with Hamuul Runetotem.
title: Hamuul Runetotem

completedText: Return to Ruga Ragetotem at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.
details: To pass this trial, you must travel south to the Field of Giants.  There you will find a host of crawling, insect creatures.  They are new to the Barrens and I do not like what they herald.$B$BBring me their still-twitching antennae, and waste no time, $N, for harvested antennae will not twitch for long.  Bring me the antennae in the time allowed, and you will pass the trial.
objectives: Bring 5 twitching antennae to Ruga Ragetotem at Camp Taurajo
title: Trial at the Field of Giants

details: Hey! You look like a hearty adventurer. If you're planning on braving the pass, do you suppose you could bring a package to the inn in Kharanos?$b$bYou were planning on stopping at the inn, right? If you make it through the pass, you'll definitely want to take a breather there.$b$bAnyways, bring this to Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant. I can't get through the pass myself, and it'll be days until a Mountaineer escort comes through!
objectives: Deliver the Crate of Inn Supplies to Tannok Frosthammer in Kharanos.
title: Supplies to Tannok

details: Now, to mix this powder in with the dew.$B$BCome back and talk to me in a minute... after I have perfected the fabulous Noggenfogger Elixir!
objectives: Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak to him again after he creates his elixir.
title: Noggenfogger Elixir

completedText: Return to Tabetha at The Quagmire in Dustwallow Marsh.
details: Long ago I possessed a beautiful piece of jewelry, the Tiara of the Deep.  And not only was it pretty--it held great power for those with the knowledge to use it.$B$BSo when word of the tiara reached the Hydromancer Velratha, she had to have it.  She sent agents to my home and they stole it while I was away.  The thieves!$B$BI want my tiara back!  Go to Zul'Farrak, the troll city in Tanaris, find Velratha and wrench the tiara from her.  Return it to me and you'll earn my favor.
objectives: Bring the Tiara of the Deep to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
title: Tiara of the Deep

details: My clanmate, Mura Runetotem, traveled to Silverpine so that she might aid our undead allies.  Silverpine is an ailing forest, a dying forest, and it was Mura's hope to bring it new life.  Perhaps the strange life found here in the Barrens can help her work in Silverpine.$B$BTake a sample of the shells you gathered, and bring it to Mura in Silverpine.  She is staying at the Sepulcher.  With luck, studying the shell will give her the insight she needs to heal that dying place.
objectives: Speak with Mura Runetotem at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
title: Mura Runetotem

completedText: Return to Andrew Brownell at the Magic Quarter in the Undercity.
details: In the Barrens lies a horrid mess of tangled vines called Razorfen Downs. While our first observations of this place revealed little threat, our recent findings are much more serious...$B$BThe quilboar of Razorfen Downs have aligned themselves with the Scourge. A Lich named Amnennar the Coldbringer rules them now, using the power of his massive consciousness to control their every move.$B$BAmnennar has a direct telepathic link to Ner'zhul; we must sever this bond, $N. An end must come to the Coldbringer.
objectives: Andrew Brownell wants you to kill Amnennar the Coldbringer and return his skull.
title: Bring the End

completedText: Return to Felix Whindlebolt at Coldridge Pass in Dun Morogh.
details: We drove the troggs out of Gnomeregan, but then it all went so horribly wrong!  Now our home is completely irradiated, and we gnomes have been scattered all over Dun Morogh.$B$BIn my haste to get away from the radiation, I lost all my personal belongings and tools.  It was the trolls that got them.  They stole my chest, my box, and my bucket of bolts!  They took them back to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.$B$BI'm no adventurer - could you find my things and bring them here to me, please?
objectives: Bring Felix's Box, Felix's Chest and Felix's Bucket of Bolts to Felix Whindlebolt in Anvilmar.
title: A Refugee's Quandary

details: Gah!  I was supposed to get this delicious scalding mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar a while ago now, but I had to deliver one to Grelin here first.  I'll never make it to Anvilmar before the brew runs cold!$B$BYou look fast.  Maybe you can make it.  This cup will only stay hot for a few more minutes, and Durnan didn't order "chilly" mornbrew, so get going.  Anvilmar is to the northeast, a settlement dug into the mountain.$B$BThanks, $N, and don't forget to bring me back my mug!
objectives: Take a Scalding Mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar before it gets cold!
title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

details: Now that hit the spot!  Nothing like a piping hot - nay, SCALDING mornbrew on a cold winter's day to warm your cackles of yer soul.$B$BHere ya go $N - be a pal and take this empty mug back to Nori for me, would ya now.
objectives: Return Nori's Mug to Nori Pridedrift in Coldridge Valley.
title: Bring Back the Mug

completedText: Return to Fallen Hero of the Horde at Splinterspear Junction in Swamp of Sorrows.
details: Razelikh's lair is atop the highest mountain in the Blasted Lands. The only way to the lair is through the use of the teleport runes near the mountain. As long as you hold the amulet, you can freely transport up to the lair. Once you reach the lair, you must conjure the beast. The amulet is your key, $N. Use it on the Altar of the Defiler.$B$BShould you defeat the Defiler, bring back his horn. It will become a symbol of hope for all that view it - proof that heroes do exist in this war torn world.$B
objectives: Destroy Razelikh the Defiler and return the Severed Horn of the Defiler to the Fallen Hero of the Horde. You will also need to return the Ward of the Defiler so that the Fallen Hero can destroy it, preventing it from ever falling into the wrong hands.$B
title: You Are Rakh'likh, Demon

details: Well, that didn't work.  I put some extra gauges on the samophlange to measure its structural integrity, and they read the integrity at an all-time low.  I could add some more dials and maybe a lever or two to try and fix it, but... I think that might make things even worse.$B$BYou should take the samophlange to Rilli Greasygob.  He used to work for the Venture Company -- if anyone knows how to fix it, it's Rilli.$B$BYou can find him at Nogg's Machine Shop in Orgrimmar, in the Valley of Honor.
objectives: Bring the Broken and Battered Samophlange to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.
title: Rilli Greasygob

completedText: Return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.
details: Along with the thorns, the blood affected <snort> other aspects of the earth: blood red stones mixed in with other minerals. The Bristleback dig up these shards and carry them as totems <snort> for strength in battle and as totems for their magics. <snort>$B$BI know the secrets of that magic.$B$BBring Mangletooth one of these blood shards to show you understand. Bring Mangletooth many of the shards, and he will bless you with quilboar magic--the magic of Agamaggan! <snort>
objectives: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.$B$BCollect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.
title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

completedText: Return to Thorkaf Dragoneye in Badlands.
details: Dragonscale leatherworking isn't easy, but it's extremely rewarding.  I'll teach you how to make this fine mail armor, but only if you agree to certain conditions.$B$BBy choosing this path, you agree never to learn elemental or tribal leatherworking; there is only room for one of the three at the apex of the craft.  Furthermore, I'll need some samples of your best work involving scorpid armor.  Finally, I'll need proof of your ability to acquire the staple of the trade: scales of the dragonkin.
objectives: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Thorkaf Dragoneye in the Badlands.$B$BCompleting this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts.$B$BThe completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.
title: Dragonscale Leatherworking

completedText: Return to Rabine Saturna at Nighthaven in Moonglade.
details: The first step is to find a container capable of holding an extremely corruptible substance without the handler suffering ill effects.  There is only one sort device I am aware of that could possibly contain something as vile as the Felvine: a Reliquary of Purity.$B$BDeep in the wasteland of Silithus is the remnants of the night elf village known as Southwind.  I know one was there many, many years ago.  If we are to succeed, I need you to scour those ruins in the hopes of reclaiming it.
objectives: Travel to Silithus and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village.  If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
title: A Reliquary of Purity

completedText: Return to Hegnar Rumbleshot in Dun Morogh.
details: Hegnar Rumbleshot sells guns off the road to Anvilmar.  Riflemen and mortar teams spend a lot of time practicing out near his shop, and he's always needing fresh ammunition.$B$BBut... the last crate of ammo I sent him got lost along the way.  My courier said he was camped near the Grizzled Den when wendigo chased him away... and the fool left Rumbleshot's ammo behind!$B$B$N, can you get that ammo and take it to Rumbleshot?  He's been waiting on it and I'm sure he's running low.
objectives: Bring Rumbleshot's Ammo to Hegnar Rumbleshot in Dun Morogh.
title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

details: The troggs are not the only thing that interested Magatha in Ragefire Chasm. She has heard word that one of her servants, a Maur Grimtotem, found something peculiar while in the Chasm, but he never made it out to show her what. She'd like Maur's body found--if it still exists--and any signs of what he found while attempting to speak to the troggs.$B$BReturn to Magatha any items of interest, and I'm sure she would be very generous in her reward.$B$BAgain, seek the Chasm in the darkest areas of Orgrimmar.
objectives: Search Ragefire Chasm for Maur Grimtotem's corpse and search it for any items of interest.
title: Searching for the Lost Satchel

completedText: Return to Rahauro at Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.
details: Beneath the city of Orgrimmar, stout creatures known as troggs started coming to the surface from deep below the lava filled tunnels. In her ever-benevolence, Magatha sought to make peace with the creatures, but they turned on her diplomats, killing them. She will not allow such treatment of the tauren people and now consider the creatures a threat to all of the Horde.$B$BShe asks that you put an end to this trogg threat before it overwhelms the Horde from below. Find Ragefire Chasm and destroy them all.
objectives: Search Orgrimmar for Ragefire Chasm, then kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shaman before returning to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
title: Testing an Enemy's Strength

details: Have you ever been to Ashenvale, to the north? The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.$B$BIf you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern Barrens, at the watch tower. He is heading up the Ashenvale campaign and can give you further orders.
objectives: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

And I cannot take that away from them... not even for their crimes against me.$B$BBut there is one thing I would ask of you to ease my brother's mind. Take this... it is the first seed that fell from the life my remains nourished. Tell him my spirit remains here, and that I live on. I am sure he will understand.

He must be stopped!$B$BTake this sacred cord, and string through it the heads of the high priests responsible for channeling our gods' energy.$B$BWhen you have done this, return to me.
objectives: String 5 Channeler's Heads, then return the Collection of Troll Heads to Exzhal on Yojamba Isle.

completedText: Report to Harlo Wigglesworth at Everlook in Winterspring.
details:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Harlo Wigglesworth in Winterspring.

He requires your help to overcome the threat of the Winterfall furbolg. To reach Winterspring, you must travel east from northern Felwood and traverse Timbermaw Hold.

Destiny calls!
objectives: Report to Harlo Wigglesworth at Everlook in Winterspring.
title: Warchief's Command: Winterspring!

completedText: Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
details:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Windcaller Proudhorn in Silithus.

Our Cenarion Circle allies require your assistance to fight back against the Twilight's Hammer onslaught. You can reach Silithus by taking the northwestern road out of the Un'Goro Crater. 

Destiny calls!
objectives: Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
title: Warchief's Command: Silithus!

completedText: Report to Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
details:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Archmage Angela Dosantos in Eastern Plaguelands. The Argent Crusade needs your help to win back the Eastern Plaguelands from the grasp of the Scourge. 

To find Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands, head northeast past Corin's Crossing to the chapel, a sanctuary amid the desolation.

Destiny calls!
objectives: Report to Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
title: Warchief's Command: Eastern Plaguelands!

details: Hero, the vile Bloodmaul ogres have overrun the southern reaches of Blade's Edge! Their brutal warriors and ferocious dire wolves threaten the stability of the region. I humbly request your aid in thinning their numbers. Journey south and slay the Bloodmaul brutes, drudgers, brewmasters, and dire wolves that stalk the land. Doing so will weaken the Bloodmaul's stranglehold and make the land safer for all.
objectives: Slay Bloodmaul ogres and wolves in Southern Blade's Edge Mountains.
title: Thinning the Bloodmaul

details: Hero, the tranquility of Winterspring is under threat! The Winterfall tribe has been consuming a mysterious firewater, driving them to madness and aggression. Their Pathfinders and Totemics have been causing havoc across these snowy plains, disrupting the balance of nature and threatening the residents of this region. We cannot let this continue. I call upon your strength and courage to put an end to their reckless acts. Thin their numbers and help restore the peace in Winterspring.
objectives: Defeat 6 Winterfall Pathfinders and 6 Winterfall Totemics in Winterspring.
title: Winterfall Purge

details: Hero, as the Winterfall tribe's aggression continues to spread throughout Winterspring, we've discovered a link between their newfound power and certain totems they possess. These are not just any ordinary totems, but ancient Timbermaw relics believed to hold significant power. We suspect the Winterfall have been corrupting these totems for their own dark purposes. We need you to recover the Timbermaw Totems of Nourishment, Might, and Power. With these totems in the right hands, we might be able to restore balance and peace to the region.
objectives: Collect the Timbermaw Totem of Nourishment, Timbermaw Totem of Might, and Timbermaw Totem of Power in Winterspring.
title: Recovering Winterfall Totems

details: Hero, a grave injustice has been done. The Winterfall tribe, in their madness and aggression, have slain many of our Timbermaw brethren and taken their paws as trophies of their heinous acts. These paws are not just symbols of our strength and unity, but they also hold spiritual significance to our people. Their loss is a painful reminder of the Winterfall tribe's ruthlessness. We implore you, brave soul, to retrieve these Timbermaw Paws so we may honor our fallen and perform the necessary rites to guide their spirits to rest.
objectives: Recover Timbermaw Paws in Winterspring.
title: Timbermaw Paws

details:
Hero, the balance between fire and ice has always been a delicate one in Winterspring. The very essence of this region is captured in the rare Frostfire Sulphur. Found only in the hot springs of this icy land, this unique element possesses properties that are vital for many sacred rituals and ancient remedies. 

However, recently, this precious resource has been diminishing. We need you to scour the hot spring and get a reading. With your aid, we can ensure the continued traditions and balance of Winterspring.
objectives: Gather a reading from the hot spring in Winterspring.
title: Frostfire Sulphur

details: Champion, a grave threat looms in Winterspring. The notorious frost elemental Collune, Tyrant of Frost, has emerged to lay claim to the Frostfire Hotsprings. Already, Collune's icy grip chokes the life from the land, and its powers grow with each passing moment. I need our mightiest hero to travel to the Hotsprings immediately and confront this menace. Slay Collune before its freezing curse spreads further across Winterspring.
objectives: Slay Collune
title: Wanted: Collune

details: Felwood, a once-vibrant forest now tainted with demonic corruption. The Deadwood tribe, under this malefic influence, wreak havoc and deepen the woods' corruption. The Deadwood Shamans, Avengers, and their vigilant Den Watchers are the driving force behind this chaos. Hero, your blade and determination are needed to stem the tide of this darkened tribe and bring hope back to Felwood.
objectives: Eliminate 6 Deadwood Shamans, 6 Deadwood Avengers, and 4 Deadwood Den Watchers in Felwood.
title: Culling the Felpaw

details: The forests of Felwood are under threat. Irontree Stompers, once guardians of the woodland, now trample its very essence, while the Toxic Horrors poison the lifeblood of the region. Hero, the land cries out for aid. Venture forth and confront these menaces, and help restore some of Felwood's natural beauty.
objectives: Slay 6 Irontree Stompers and 6 Toxic Horrors.
title: Timber and Blight

details: The malevolent Jadefire satyrs, remnants of a cursed past, spread their treachery and dark magic throughout Felwood. With their Hellcallers leading dark rituals, Betrayers sowing discord, and Tricksters deceiving the innocent, their reign threatens to plunge the forest into irreversible darkness. Hero, it is upon you to intervene. Exorcise the Jadefire threat and bring respite to the tainted woods.
objectives: Exterminate 6 Jadefire Hellcallers, 6 Jadefire Betrayers, and 6 Jadefire Tricksters in Felwood.
title: Demon Dispersal: Exorcising the Jadefire

details: Felwood, a land tainted by corruption, holds secrets that may aid in its restoration. The Deadwood Furbolgs carry totems imbued with their twisted energies, the Irontree ancients bear unique barks resistant to the land's blight, and the Jadefire Satyrs possess horns brimming with malevolent magic. Hero, gather these items for study, and perhaps we can find a way to reverse the damage done to this once-thriving forest.
objectives: Collect Deadwood Totems, Irontree Barks, and Jadefire Horns.
title: Elements of Corruption

details: Hero, dire news from Jadefire Run. A sinister satyr named Zazzuth'ul leads vicious raids across Felwood, leaving only ruin in his wake. If left unchecked, this rogue and his followers will despoil all they touch. I need a legendary champion to venture to Jadefire Run and slay Zazzuth'ul, before the satyr's corruption spreads further across the land.
objectives: Slay Zazzuth’ul
title: Wanted: Zazzuth’ul

details: The Scarlet Crusade, once revered paladins and priests, have lost their way, now harboring fanatical ideals that threaten the very lands they claim to protect. Among their ranks, the Scarlet Warders, Enchanters, and Clerics wield significant power and influence, advancing their zealous cause. It falls upon you, Hero, to confront these key figures and curb the Scarlet Crusade's strength. Head into their territory, confront their might and magic, and ensure the safety of the innocents they threaten.
objectives: Eliminate 6 Scarlet Warders, 6 Scarlet Enchanters, and 6 Scarlet Clerics.
title: Scarlet Sweep: Magic and Might

details: Tyr's Hand, a bastion of the Scarlet Crusade's fanaticism, stands defiantly, with its cathedral representing their misguided zeal. To challenge their dominion and send a clear message of resistance, we've crafted a flag that embodies the true spirit of the land. Hero, your mission is not just to place this flag outside the cathedral but to defend it against any who would see it torn down. By doing so, we strike at the very heart of their faith and inspire hope in those they oppress.
objectives: Place the challenge flag outside the cathedral in Tyr's Hand and defend it against Scarlet Crusade attackers.
title: Flagging Their Faith in Tyr's Hand

details: The strength of the Scarlet Crusade lies not just in their numbers, but in the capabilities of their elite. The Scarlet Praetorians, formidable guardians of their cause; the Scarlet Curates, spiritual guides steeped in zealotry; and the Scarlet Archmages, masters of arcane with fanatical devotion. These figures represent the backbone of their order. Hero, for peace to stand a chance in these troubled lands, these elites must be confronted and their threat neutralized. Venture into the heart of their domain and break the chains of their dominance.
objectives: Defeat 6 Scarlet Praetorians, 6 Scarlet Curates, and 6 Scarlet Archmages.
title: Breaking the Scarlet Elite

details: The Scarlet Crusade, in their unyielding fanaticism, bears emblems representing their order and cause. These symbols, often worn by their members in Tyr's Hand, not only serve as a badge of allegiance but also carry information and plans crucial to their operations. By gathering these emblems, we can decode their strategies and gain the upper hand. Hero, venture into the heart of Tyr's Hand and retrieve these Scarlet Emblems. Their secrets will be our key to dismantling their efforts.
objectives: Collect Scarlet Emblems from members of the Scarlet Crusade in Tyr's Hand.
title: Emblem-atic Endeavors

details: Champion, a grim task awaits in Tyr's Hand. The fanatical paladin Zealot Francena leads bloody crusades from there, rallying the Scarlet Crusade around her. Francena must be stopped, but her faith drives her to zealotry. I am entrusting you with the burden of ending the paladin's reign by any means necessary. Fight your way through Tyr's Hand and slay Zealot Francena.
objectives: Slay Zealot Francena
title: Wanted: Zealot Francena

details: Quel'Lithien Lodge, situated in the northern reaches of the Eastern Plaguelands, was once a beacon of elven civilization. Its denizens, primarily Woodsmen, Rangers, and Pathstriders, lived harmoniously, safeguarding the borders of the elven territories. However, in recent times, a strange animosity has taken root within them. Their aggression towards outsiders threatens the fragile peace we've established in the Plaguelands. Hero, journey to the Quel'Lithien Lodge and quell the aggression of these elves, so that we might uncover the root of their sudden change.
objectives: Travel to Quel'Lithien Lodge and slay 8 Woodsmen, 8 Rangers, and 4 Pathstriders.
title: Quel'Lithien Unrest

details: The Eastern Plaguelands are riddled with numerous threats, not the least of which are the vile creatures that emerge from the crypts and mausoleums scattered across the land. The Crypt Fiends, Walkers, and Horrors are abominations that are believed to be the remnants of adventurers and villagers who were unfortunate enough to fall victim to the Scourge's malevolent influence. These creatures now roam the lands, spreading fear and darkness. Hero, the time has come to confront these undead menaces and put an end to their terror.
objectives: Venture across the Eastern Plaguelands and slay 6 Crypt Fiends, 6 Crypt Walkers, and 4 Crypt Horrors.
title: Crypt Crawler's Demise

details: The Plaguelands, once a lush region, is now a land of nightmares and sorrow. Among the countless abominations that roam these cursed grounds are the Stitched Horrors, creations of dark necromancy, the ravenous Cannibal Ghouls, and the Cursed Mages, damned souls that wield twisted magics. Their unending hunger for the living threatens the few sanctuaries we have managed to establish. Hero, we must ensure the safety of these havens. Venture into the heart of the Plaguelands and quell the hunger of these damned creatures.
objectives: Seek out and slay 6 Stitched Horrors, 6 Cannibal Ghouls, and 4 Cursed Mages in the Eastern Plaguelands.
title: Hunger of the Damned

details: In the wake of the Scourge's devastation, many of the land's treasures and artifacts were lost, now lying in the grasp of the vile creatures that roam the Plaguelands. The Elvish Trinkets are remnants of a once-great civilization, Crypt Cloths bear inscriptions that could be key to understanding the undead, and the Plagued Plasma holds potent energies that our scholars are keen to study. Hero, as you confront the abominations of this land, keep an eye out for these items. Their retrieval could be essential in understanding and combating the dark powers that linger here.
objectives: Gather Elvish Trinkets, Crypt Cloths, and Plagued Plasmas from the undead of the Eastern Plaguelands.
title: Unearthly Treasures

details: Hero, deep beneath the azure waters of Azshara, followers of the mighty Arkkoroc have begun to amass. These disciples, known as the Arkoran, were once dormant, but recent disturbances in the arcane leylines have reawakened their fealty to the ancient sea giant. Their growing presence and allegiance pose a significant threat to the balance of power within Azshara. Your strength and expertise are required to confront and quell these devout followers before they can fully execute their master's will.
objectives: Slay 6 Arkoran Clackers, 6 Arkoran Muckdwellers, and 6 Arkoran Oracles in the submerged regions of Azshara.
title: Disciples of Arkkoroc

objectives: Slay 6 Legashi Satyrs, 6 Legashi Hellcallers, and 6 Legashi Rogues in the forested areas of Azshara.
title: Shadows of the Legashi

details: Hero, a new threat has set foot in Azshara. Blood Elf Surveyors and Reclaimers have been spotted trying to extract arcane energy and ancient relics from the land. Their meddling with Azshara's treasures not only disrupts the balance but risks awakening dormant dangers. We cannot stand by as they pillage and drain the magical essence of this place. Venture forth and halt their advances, ensuring the arcane sanctity of Azshara remains intact.
objectives: Slay 6 Blood Elf Surveyors and 6 Blood Elf Reclaimers in Azshara.
title: Elven Intrusion

details: Hero, the vast expanses of Azshara hold relics and artifacts of immense power and historical significance. Recently, we've learned of three particular items of interest: the Blood Elf Artefact from their surveyors, the Arkkoran Relic from the depths where the Arkoran reside, and the Legashi Grimoire, a dark tome held by the Legashi satyrs. Each holds a piece of Azshara's history and potential power. It's imperative that these artifacts be secured and studied to ensure they do not fall into the wrong hands.
objectives: Gather the Blood Elf Artifacts from Blood Elf locations, the Arkkoran Relic from Arkoran regions, and the Legashi Grimoire from areas where the Legashi satyrs dwell in Azshara.
title: Echoes of Azshara

details:
Legends say that long ago, Arkkoran ruled the seas alongside his brother, Arkkalash, but Arkkalash was lured by dark whispers from the depths of the sea, and tried to slay his brother. For his actions he was banished to the depths of the sea.

It is impossible to confirm these legends, but a sea giant claiming to be Arkkalash has appeared around the Temple of Arkkoran, trying to sway Arkkoran's disciples against their god.

title: Wanted: Arkkalash

I beseech you, brave champion, to hunt down this villain. Journey into Plaguewood's rotted forests, find the necromancer's lair, and slay him so his evil spreads no further.

completedText: Return to Efry Cogspark at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.
details:
Oh blast it all! This is bad…this is really bad…hey, you! Yeah, you! You want a job? Good. I’ve got one. Okay, calm down Efry, calm down…

So I was making a bot and I tried to make it smart! I was going to make a bot slow down, sorry. I made a bot, Intelligent Automated Security Guardian, or Nylrisa. What, you think I’m gonna go around calling it Iasg? No way! Nylrisa is my pride and joy, why, she’ll shape our concept of technology as we know it! Why, she’s probably a better strategist than you or I! With Nylrisa guarding your home, even a team of coordinated adventurers wouldn’t stand a chance!

At least…that was the idea…

Nylrisa has gone rogue. She left, who knows where, but with everything she’s capable of…well, this really isn’t good. I mean, I sorta gave her the ability to control bots and…look, this wasn’t supposed to happen, okay? Look, she attacked the Frostmane trolls over nearby, seems like she didn’t finish the job, but maybe she left something behind.
objectiveText0: Search for clues to Nylrisa's location.
objectives: Search the Frostmane Encampment for Clues.
title: A Small Mistake

completedText: Return to Efry Cogspark at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.
details:
Alright, I got it! She’s not even that far out, just in the south end of Coldridge Valley. You should hurry before she leaves, and…you might have to destroy her, but try not to damage the internal components more than you have to. I just need to figure out what happened, make a few adjustments, and everything will be good, I swear!

But she’s still a danger right now, so get moving and go shut her down! I’ll…figure the rest out later.
objectives: Search for Nylrisa to the south-west of Brewnall Village.
title: We Found Her!

completedText: Return to Soslenu Irontusks at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
details:
The human fort atop the mountain has long been too close for comfort. Warchief Thrall ordered us to leave them alone, and leave them alone we have, as they had done the same in kind.

But yesterday my daughter was cut down by human blade, and though she lives, it is only by the strength of her will. She is not a warrior, she was only gathering food for our dinner.

The peace our warchief wishes will not happen while they seek bloodshed, I am sure he too will understand.
objectives: Slay Theramore Marines and Theramore Menders at Fort Airheart
title: Blood Must Have Blood

completedText: Return to Hausisse Irontusks at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
details:
You...please, listen...

When they left me for dead...they said Captain Farran...ordered them to attack...

...Wants war...with Taurajo...

<The Tauren seems to be struggling to talk through her injuries, but it sounds like you should kill this Captain Farran.>
objectives: Kill Captain Farran at Fort Airheart.
title: Daelin's Legacy

completedText: Bring the materials to Rhuna in the Barrens along with 3 Silver as payment.
details:
Ahh…so de flute weren’t enough to stir her spirit. Shame, mon. It sang sweet, but her heart still be heavy.

Still-we ain’t givin’ up! No, no, we just need somethin’ stronger. Somethin’ louder...a drum! Yes, dat be it!

Rhuna, de leatherworker, could stitch one together for us if she had de right materials...would you be willin' to do dat for me poor old sister?
objectives: Maybe a flute was the wrong instrument. Gather 5 Hecklefang Hyena skins, 1 Barrens Giraffe Leather, and 3 silver. Then deliver it to Unah to make a drum.
title: Finding the Rhythm

completedText: Return to Martin Lesterfield at the Crossroads.
details:
Ah! What opportune timing!

I am in dire need of a capable assistant! Yes, yes… you’ll do nicely.

The Burning Blade cultists have taken refuge upon the mountain just north of here, I wish to decode their scripture!

I don't care how you get it, bring me their writings so I-we may harness their power for our own!
objectives: Hearing of the power of the Burning Blade cult, Martin asks you to retrieve some of their demonic scriptures from Burning Blade Acolytes, and Burning Blade Bruisers so he can study them and perhaps learn something of their power.
title: Understanding the Scriptures

details:
Problem with Venture, they get everywhere!

Now they're in my mines too! Perfectly good, mines full of very valuable gems, and they decided to help themselves!

You've proven good at takin' those loses down a peg, go over to that mine and just do what you did last time!

If Arragoth succeeds, the Legion's army in Outland will be bolstered considerably. Seek out Overseer Arragoth where he lurks near the Forge Base and put an end to his sinister plans before the Legion's war machine grows any stronger. The fields of Netherstorm must not host these engines of destruction!
objectives: Slay Overseer Arragoth

We urgently require the assistance of a hero to delve into the mystical forests, navigate treacherous paths, and gather precious timber from hidden groves. Your valorous efforts will not go unrewarded, as a nifty prize awaits those who can help us overcome this catastrophe. Join us in our fight to restore abundance and prosperity to Azeroth. Report to the quest board now and be hailed as the savior of our realm! Together, we shall overcome this timber crisis and build a brighter future for all.

details:
Death isn't the end, and on Ascension you have additional tools to deal with death.

You will find 2 Spells in the General Tab of your Spellbook that can only be used while you are dead.

Resurrect in Capital City will resurrect and teleport you to your faction's closest capital city.

Resurrect in Closest Town will teleport you to your faction's closest town. This is usually your current Zone's Quest Hub.

These spells will allow you to avoid resurrecting in dangerous areas, escape campers in PvP, or just speed up your play session by avoiding a corpse run when you'd rather move on to a new area or quest.

Next time you die, try Resurrecting in Closest Town or Capital City.

Attention all Heroes of Azeroth: There have been reports of a formidable demon known as Kazzak spotted in the Blasted Lands. Also known as Kil'jaeden's Right Hand and Lord of the Doomguard demons, Kazzak was known as one of Archimonde's most trusted lieutenants during the Third War. He is a formidable and powerful demon of the Burning Legion
Kazzak, wielding the fabled blade of Archimonde, was last seen in the Blasted Lands at the Tainted Scar.

Rally together your fellow heroes to save the world of Azeroth from the Burning Legion. The item will not drop if you do not have item level 50 or higher.
objectives: Defeat Lord Kazzak!
title: A Threat to Azeroth: Kazzak (High-Risk)

details:
Attention all Heroes of Azeroth: Disturbing news has reached us of the vile troll warlock, Atal'zul the Soulreaver, being sighted in the ruins of Zul'Mashar in Eastern Plaguelands. Once a respected shadow hunter, Atal'zul became corrupted by dark voodoo magic, turning him into a feared servant of the troll god Hakkar the Soulflayer.

Atal'zul now performs profane rituals, tormenting the souls of the Amani slain at Zul'Mashar. His vile necromancy also raises their corpses as zombies under his command.

We must unite to stop Atal'zul before he amasses an undead troll army to wreak havoc across Azeroth! Rally your forces and venture to Zul'Mashar!
objectives: Destroy Atal'zul the Soulreaver!
title: A Threat to Azeroth: Atal'zul the Soulreaver

completedText: Inspect the corpse of the dead crewman.
details: Ah, a traveler! One look at your garb and I knew you’d come from afar.$b$bCome closer, look. This newborn of mine suffers from an illness no healer has managed to cure. He has little time left. But his older brother refuses to accept that.$b$bSomewhere along the way, he heard whispers of a “congregation” claiming to have a cure for all ailments. Grelbin clung to that hope like a drowning man to driftwood, and left to find them.$b$bThat was two weeks ago. He hasn’t returned yet, and worse, the wind now carries an ugly black smoke from the direction I last saw him go. I fear the worst.$b$bPlease… follow in his footsteps, and bring him back to me. The gods have already judged that I must give up one son. I won’t lose them both.
objectives: Follow in the footsteps of Grelbin, son of Groldha, and investigate the source of the smoke.
title: Smoke on the Wind

details: <Before looting the body, you reason that the goblin won’t be missing the papers in his pocket.>$b$b<Thumbing through them, you piece together that the goblin was part of a crew sent to locate a mysterious group of ascetics in the Coldridge Mountains; the very same group Grelbin, Groldha’s son, went searching for.>$b$b<Among the papers, you find a map marking a path up the mountain to the ascetics’ hidden domain.>
objectives: Follow the mountain path to uncover the location of the mysterious group.
title: A Promising Path

details: Up ahead are the gates to Radiance Town, a rat’s nest of that sect’s rabble. They call themselves “The Radiants.” I’ve been keeping watch on them for a month now.$b$bThey believe bathing in the same radiation that devastated Gnomeregan will grant them some kind of revelation, or Light knows what.$b$bThey’re dangerous; heretics as well as rebels. Their leader’s crowned himself king, if you can believe it. And I have orders to see him executed.$b$bNow that you’re here… a plan comes to mind.$b$bFollow the road, scout the forest ahead, and cut down a few of those zealots. Bring me back some pieces of their armor. I’ve got an idea… you’ll see!
objectives: Slay Radiant fanatics and collect their armor pieces. Deliver them to Arathror so he can craft a disguise.
title: A Fitting Disguise

completedText: Return to Anvilmar and tell Groldha what you learned about her son and the sect.
details: I’ve had too many run-ins with the Radiant; they’d spot me in a heartbeat. You, though… you’re new. An unknown face.$b$bAye, I think this disguise will pass. Let me know when you’re ready and I’ll help you into it. No, not like that, don’t be daft.$b$bOnce you’re disguised, keep your head down. Cross the village to the far side without drawing attention, and find their so-called king. Most cults fall apart without a strong leader.$b$bIf this is one of them, you might just be in time to save Groldha’s son from losing his mind.
objectiveText0: Ask Arathror to help you put on the disguise
objectives: Tell Arathror when you’re ready to don the disguise. Then infiltrate Radiance Town and slay the cult leader, His Radiant Majesty.
title: His Radiant Majesty

completedText: Bring the harvested mutagens to Redna.
details: If you can sneak your way into Radiance Town… there’s something I could use your help with.$b$bI’ve been trying to understand how radiation works, looking for a way to counter its effects. For that purpose… I built this:$b$b<Redna shows you a contraption that only vaguely resembles a rifle.>$b$bKill a few radioactive slimes, then pull the trigger on this beauty. It’ll siphon the essence out of the slime and, with luck, let me isolate the mutagen.
objectives: Slay radioactive slimes in Radiance Town and use the Contamination Extractor on their corpses to harvest mutagen.
title: Deciphering Radiation

details: New around here?$b$bForgive me; might be I’ve run into you before, but my memory… it flickers, in and out, like a dying bulb.$b$bFriend or stranger, I could use your help. <Lahud stifles a guilty little giggle, clearly embarrassed.> Don’t think I’m trying to weasel out of my duty; I meant to do it, truly! But then I got woozy…$b$b<The gnome swallows back a burp and jerks upright, twitching as if he’d grabbed a live wire.>$b$bAll you need to do is spray a bit of blessed radiation on some of the townsfolk. You know, their weekly dose. Do this for me and I’ll be forever in your debt!
objectives: Use the Radiation Sprayer to douse Radiaville’s townsfolk with radiation.
title: Soaking the Masses

details: Have you run into the exile, Redna?$bShe pitched her camp on the hill just above us.$b$bLast time I spoke with her, she said something I haven’t been able to shake off:$b“The only one who’ll defend a lie fiercer than the liar is the fool who believed it.”$b$bThe one they call “The Right Hand of His Majesty” is living proof of that. He’s no ordinary follower; Redna swears he’s crueler, more despotic, and more fanatical than his master.$b$bIf you’ve the steel for it, cut him down while you’re making your way through Radiance Town. Then, report to Redna. She and him had… unfinished business.
objectives: Defeat Right Hand of His Majesty in Radiance Town.
title: Sever the Right Hand

details: Chisels, hammers, squares, compasses... that's what we have in abundance here, the Masons' Lodge. Swords, bows, staves, axes? We wouldn't even know which end to hold. You, on the other hand...$b$bEast of here, dug in along Brightwater Lake, a band of rebels has rejected the Dark Lady's rule; simple-minded fools who think the living will greet them with open arms.$b$bMy brother is among them. If I wait for Magistrate Sevren to send his Deathstalkers, word will get out; my name stained, and with it my spotless standing as head of the lodge.$b$bPut the rebels down. Leave none alive. And above all, make certain my brother does not walk away.
objectives: Find the Forsaken Rebels entrenched along the shores of Brightwater Lake and put them down.
title: Spotless Standing

details: <The dwarf waves from afar to catch your eye; big sweeping arms at first, then he starts hopping in place.>$b$bWell met! <pants> I saw how you handled Groldha. I'm guessing you won't be lingering in Anvilmar much longer...$b$bIf that's the case and your feet carry you to Kharanos, I've a message that needs delivering.$b$bFind Eyma at the inn and tell her the talks in Anvilmar bore fruit. They want a shipment of our best ale; if it wins them over, we've got ourselves regular buyers. The ancestors smile on us, $C!
objectives: Speak with Eyma Thunderbrew at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos.
title: A Growing Business

details: Nori must've seen something in you, to trust you with that message.$b$bSince you're here, maybe you can lend a hand.$b$bStep out of the inn and look left; you'll see the distillery's hop yard. Special strain of hops, for the finest brew in all Dun Morogh.$b$bWe're swamped today with customers. Would you mind picking hops and bringing them back to me? Hardly hero's work, I know. But it pays, and it pays well.
objectives: Harvest seven Thunderbrew Hops from the Thunderbrew Distillery grounds in Kharanos.
title: Thunderbrew's Hop

details: Careful! The tunnel's been impassable for a few days now.$b$bMy inventions, the automata I built with these very hands <he shakes them in your face, more comic than tragic>, have betrayed me. They've turned on me!$b$bNow they attack anything that wanders close. They've already claimed a life and, worse yet, they've wrecked my reputation!$b$bDon't go into that tunnel unless... <the gnome's eyes take on an opportunistic glint>.$b$bYou're not like the others, now that I look at you. You might just survive them. Destroy them... That's it! Go in there, take them apart, and bring me their parts.
objectives: Defeat Out-of-Control Automata clogging the Kharanos tunnel and recover Reusable Mechanical Parts from their remains.
title: Bots on Strike

details: <The dwarf braces a blunderbuss between his knees and runs a rod down the barrel; push, twist, pull, until the grime comes loose and spatters out.>$b$bSorry, didn't notice I had an audience.$b$bFancy putting a few rounds downrange? Targets are always hungry for lead; with luck, we'll catch a buyer's eye.$b$bAll this ammunition isn't going to sell itself.
objectives: Test Gornarn's Blunderbuss and ammo on the practice targets up on the ridge above Kharanos.
title: Live-Fire Demo

You can quickly find Innkeepers by clicking the magnifying lense on your mini-map and selecting Innkeeper.

completedText: Now that you have chosen a profession you can gain skills in your profession by crafting or gathering. As you gain in skill, you will unlock new recipes! Visit a Professional Trainer in any capital city or use a portable Book of Artisans to learn more advanced recipes as you grow in skill.
details:
Professions are an important part of developing your character crafting your identity. Professions fall into two categories, Crafting and Gathering.

Many professions naturally pair well together, like Herbalism and Alchemy or Mining and Blacksmith.

You can only learn two primary professions, but can learn as many secondary professions as you would like.

Secondary professions include First Aid, Cooking and Fishing.

Speak to the Beginner's Book of Artisans and pick a profession! You can always unlearn your profession and pick a new one later.
objectiveText0: Visit a Book of Artisans and learn a Profession
objectives: Visit the Beginner's Book of Artisans outside the inn and learn a profession.

completedText:
Return to the Call Board.

You are now queued for the dungeon(s) you selected!

You will see an animated Green Eye icon to the bottom left of your minimap indicating you are in the queue. Mouse over this icon to see your queue status.

Once 5 players have been found, you will see a pop-up notification indicating your group is ready. Once everyone hits accept, you and your new group will be teleported into the dungeon.
details:
Dungeons are a great way to gain levels and powerful gear!

The Dungeon Finder is a queue system that you can use solo, or with a group of players.

Dungeons can be queue'd for as a Tank, Healer or Damage. You should always be sure you have a build that supports the role you are queueing for. If you have multiple specializations, you can consider creating builds for each role and queueing for more than one role to speed up your queue times!

After you've selected your role, click "Find a Group" at the bottom of the panel. 

Once queued, you will see a Green Eye Icon on your minimap, and you can mouseover the icon to see your queue status. When the group fills up, you will see a pop-up notification and be teleported to the dungeon with the rest of your party when everyone accepts.
objectiveText0: Open the Dungeon Finder by hitting I or click the Green Eye icon in your options menu
objectiveText1: Select the dungeon(s) you want to queue for then click Find Group
objectives: Open the Dungeon Finder by hitting (I) or click the Green Eye icon in your options menu, select a dungeon and click Find Group.
title: Path to Ascension: Dungeon Finder

details:
Greetings, Recruit!

Some trainers cling to the old ways, sending fresh adventurers trudging across the land for what feels like forty miles uphill both ways. That won’t be necessary here. You’ll learn Novice Riding for a nominal fee, granting you your first mount and a steady 40% increase in speed.

There’s more than enough to keep you busy on your journey - discovering treasures, honing your skills, and testing your mettle. No sense slowing you down when the world is waiting.

Here, we’d rather see you ride than wear out your boots. When you’ve gained more skill, and coin, you may return to a riding trainer to improve your riding skill and increase your mount speed even further.
